criteria.criterion: Anthropic transport fallback wait applies Equal Jitter `uniform(cap/2, cap)` (not plain `wait_exponential`); a held-out test asserts two synthesized concurrent 429-without-Retry-After retries draw different sleeps (de-correlation), bounded by `llm_retry_max_wait_s`.
A `Retry-After: 0` (and expired HTTP-date) is treated as absent → jittered fallback, NOT immediate replay; test asserts sleep > 0 within the jitter window.
A positive `Retry-After` within `llm_retry_max_wait_s` is still honored (regression guard).

citations.description: Phase 2 comment (timestamp 1788134437980495067): 'Gerrit change 2448 (patchset 2). LLM-Review +1 (PASS) was received on PS1... Ticket stays in_progress; will close... only after the change merges to origin/main (Verified +1) and the completion gate passes.'

findings.criterion: `make lint && make typecheck && make test` green; lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1).
findings.detail: The ticket's Phase 2 comment attests `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test` green (with specifics: ruff, mypy 716 files, 236 tests), and LLM-Review +1 on Gerrit change 2448. However, the criterion also requires Gerrit Verified +1 (merge to origin/main). The ticket is explicitly still `in_progress` and the Phase 2 comment states it will close only after the change merges (Verified +1). No Verified +1 attestation is visible in the ticket snapshot — the change is up for review but not yet merged.
findings.remediation: Record a ticket comment naming the Gerrit change 2448 merge commit SHA, the Verified +1 vote, and the timestamp when it merged to origin/main.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[non-codebase]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify. Note that a finding reporting a ticket record as absent means it was NOT VISIBLE IN THE TICKET SNAPSHOT THE VERIFIER READ — that snapshot is pinned when the run starts, so a record written after the pin, or not yet committed to the store, reads as missing even though it exists; re-verify after the write lands rather than re-recording evidence you already wrote.
